description: Rename the open assembly display name. assembly_id is an opaque surf id, not the current name. Names may collide. Working copy only; moved is false. git_save writes the same assemblies/<id>.surf.json. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

name.description: New display label. Working copy only; not unique.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: rename_assembly
